sections.question: In which calendar quarter did EOG's reported crude oil output first include production from Bahrain, and in which did it first include production from the United Arab Emirates? Give the Bahrain quarter first.
sections.reasoning:
Step 1. Doc 6 (first quarter 2026 supplemental data), Volumes and Prices: the "Other International (B)" crude oil and condensate row prints a dash for 1Q 2025, 2Q 2025 and 3Q 2025, then 0.1 MBbld for 4Q 2025, a dash for full-year 2025, and 0.1 for 1Q 2026. Its footnote (B) says "Production volumes from Bahrain operations". So the first Bahrain crude output is in 4Q 2025, and the 1Q 2026 output in that row also came only from Bahrain.
Step 2. Doc 7 (second quarter 2026 supplemental data): the same row repeats those values and adds 0.5 for 2Q 2026 and 0.3 for 2026 to date. Its footnote (B) says "Crude oil and condensate volumes are from UAE and Bahrain operations", and its endnote 1 says "2025 volumes are from Bahrain operations".
Step 3. Doc 7 is the only document that names the UAE. Its 2025 volumes were Bahrain only (Doc 7 endnote 1) and its 1Q 2026 volume was Bahrain only (Doc 6 footnote B), so the UAE output first appears in 2Q 2026. Answer: 4Q 2025 (Bahrain), then 2Q 2026 (UAE).
Decoys: Doc 5 (third quarter 2025 data) is the first to name Bahrain ("Other International represents EOG's Kingdom of Bahrain operations"), but its only Other International figure is a natural gas price (3.27 for 3Q 2025); it has no crude row, so 3Q 2025 is not a crude quarter. Reading Doc 7's footnote alone as covering both 2026 quarters would give 1Q 2026 for the UAE, which Doc 6's footnote rules out.
